players.bio: André Filipe Claro de Jesus (born 31 March 1991), known as Claro, is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays for F.C. Arouca as a forward. Football career Born in Vila Nova de Gaia, Porto District, Claro arrived in F.C. Porto's youth system in 2002, aged 11. He went on to progress through every youth rank at the club, being occasionally summoned to the first team for training.
Antef Tsoungui (born 30 December 2002) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Primeira Liga club Estoril.

Duarte Urtigueira Gouveia Beirão Valente (born 2 November 1999), is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays for G.D. Estoril Praia as a midfielder. Club career On 14 August 2017, Valente made his professional debut with Estoril Praia in a 2017–18 Primeira Liga match against Vitória Guimarães.

Ewandro Felipe de Lima Costa (born 15 March 1996), known as Ewandro, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays for Portuguese club Estoril, on loan from Italians Udinese, as a forward. Club career São Paulo Ewandro joined São Paulo in 2009.

Fernando Medrano Gastañaga (born 26 March 2000) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a left-back for CD Tenerife. A youth product of Atlético Madrid since 2007, Medrano started playing with their reserves in 2019 and joined the senior team for the preseason in the summer of 2020. On 4 March 2020, he signed a professional contract with the club until 2023.
Francisco Reis Ferreira (born 26 March 1997), commonly known as Ferro, is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays for Benfica as a centre-back.

Gonçalo Jardim Brandão (born 9 October 1986 in Lisbon) is a Portuguese footballer who plays for G.D. Estoril Praia. Mainly a central defender, he can also appear as a left back. Club career Belenenses A product of hometown C.F.
Alejandro "Jandro" Orellana Gómez (born 7 August 2000) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays for Portuguese Primeira Liga club Estoril.
João António Antunes Carvalho (born 9 March 1997) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Super League Greece club Olympiacos.

Joel António Soares Ferreira (born 10 January 1992), known simply as Joel, is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays for G.D. Estoril Praia as a left back. Football career Born in Valongo, Porto District, Joel spent his first four years as a senior with local Gondomar S.C. in the third division. In summer 2015 he signed with C.D.

Joel Robles Blázquez (Spanish pronunciation: ; born 17 June 1990) is a Spanish professional footballer who currently plays as a goalkeeper for Saudi First Division League club Al-Qadsiah. Robles started his professional career at Atlético Madrid, initially in the C team in 2008, before progressing into the B team a year later, before being promoted into the senior squad.

Jordan William Holsgrove (born 10 September 1999) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Paços de Ferreira. Club career Reading Born in Edinburgh while his father was representing Hibernian, Holsgrove returned to England a few months later, and was a Reading youth graduate. On 13 February 2017, he signed his first professional contract with the club.

Kléber Laube Pinheiro (born 2 May 1990), known simply as Kléber, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays for Portuguese club G.D. Estoril Praia as a striker. Brazil Born in Estância Velha, Rio Grande do Sul, Kléber started his career with Clube Atlético Mineiro, also having finished his formation at the Belo Horizonte club.

Lucas Cavalcante Silva Afonso (born 23 March 1996), known as Lucão, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays for Estoril as a central defender. Club career Lucão made his Série A debut at 17 November 2013 against Fluminense in a 2-1 away defeat. He played the first half and was substituted at half time by Caramelo.
Marcelo Carné (born February 9, 1991 in Rio de Janeiro), is a Brazilian goalkeeper who plays for Juventude.

Martin Turk (born 21 August 2003) is a Slovenian professional footballer who plays for Italian Serie A club Parma as a goalkeeper. Born in Koper, Turk played in the youth sectors of Jadran Dekani and Koper, before joining Italian side Parma in 2019, aged 15. He made his professional debut for the club on 22 February 2022, in a goalless Serie B draw against Pisa.
Matheus da Cunha Gomes (born 28 February 1996), commonly known as Matheus Índio or only Índio, is a Brazilian footballer who plays for Estoril as an attacking midfielder.

Edson André Sitoe (born 8 September 1988), known as Mexer, is a Mozambican professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Estoril, and the Mozambique national team. Brought to Europe by Sporting CP in 2010, he played 96 Primeira Liga games for Olhanense and Nacional.
Pedro Filipe Tinoco Monteiro (born 30 January 1994 in Paços de Ferreira) is a Portuguese footballer who plays for G.D. Estoril Praia as a central defender.
Rafik Guitane (born 26 May 1999) is an Algerian professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or winger for Primeira Liga club G.D. Estoril Praia.
Ricard Sánchez Sendra (born 22 February 2000) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a right-back or right wing-back for Granada CF.
Stelios Andreou (born 24 July 2002) is a Cypriot professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Ekstraklasa club Widzew Łódź and the Cyprus national team.

Thiago Cardoso (born 4 August 1991) is a Brazilian footballer who plays as a defender for the Primeira Liga side Estoril. Career Mineiro He began his playing career at Clube Atlético Mineiro, making his debut in national league on 16 August 2009. He played the full match that losing to Corinthians 0–2. He played his second appearance on 2 September, replacing Wason Rentería in the 70th minute.

Thierry Ramos da Graça (born 27 January 1995) is a Cape Verdean professional footballer who plays for Portuguese club G.D. Estoril Praia as a goalkeeper. Club career He started his career in Cape Verde. In 2013, he joined Portuguese club AD Oeiras to play in the U-19 league before moving to Benfica's youth team in the middle of the season.

Victor Andrade Santos (born 30 September 1995) is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays for Portuguese club G.D. Estoril Praia. Club career Santos Born in Carmópolis, Sergipe, Victor Andrade joined Vitória's youth setup in 2005, aged 10. A year later he moved to Benfica in a trial basis, remaining in the club for a couple of months and appearing in youth tournaments with the Lisbon club.
Xavier "Xavi" Sintes Egea (born 5 August 2001) is a Spanish footballer who plays as either a centre-back or a central midfielder for Córdoba CF.

Miguel Ângelo da Silva Rocha (born 10 November 1994), known as Xeka (Portuguese pronunciation: ), is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Ligue 1 club Rennes. Formed at Braga, he spent several years at Lille in Ligue 1, making 145 appearances and winning the league in 2020–21.
Yanis Begraoui (born 4 July 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Ligue 1 club Toulouse. Born in France, he represents Morocco at youth level.
